item.title: How Dabo Swinney REALLY feels about that Alabama onside kick in the national championship!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Dabo Swinney joins "Beat Everyone" to talk about his Clemson Tigers' historic battles with Nick Saban and the Alabama Crimson Tide. He looks back on Adam Griffith's game-changing onside kick from the 2015 national title game, plus why Clemson dominated Alabama by 28 in the 2018 College Football Playoff final.

item.title: DABO SWINNEY on his BATTLES with Nick Saban, the LEGEND Gene Stallings, Alabama's HISTORIC 1992 team
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Legendary Clemson head coach and former Alabama football player Dabo Swinney joins Ben Flanagan to talk about how the emergence of the 24-team College Football Playoff means the death of conference title games, including the SEC Championship. Swinney played on the 1992 Crimson Tide team that won the inaugural SEC title game and the national championship, so he has some incredible memories. Swinney also talks about playing for and coaching under the legend Gene Stallings, plus is all-time battles against Nick Saban and Alabama in the College Football Playoff era.

item.description:
